review_description: Good sales presentation,  deposit paid in October  but no installation date  despite at least two follow-up calls/ emails from me

The salesman and installer were both brilliant. The system is performing as promised.Unfortunately, they over promised during the Christmas period and my installation was delayed  several times. Perhaps they are suffering growing pains. Also their admin systems need some tweaking ( e.g. asking for payment prior to installation....more than once)

The sales guy, AJ was punctual, knowledgeable and answered most of my questions, either at the time or later by email.The installation went well. The team of two where on time, took the time they said it would take. They kept me in the loop during the install. They cleaned up after the install was completed.They explained the system and gave a demonstration of the back up function.I was left up to my own devices using the FoxESS app, however the installer couldn't connect to my system once I had logged on. He did give my a run down of the basic functions in the app.

The sales rep answered all my questions and provided the information without any hard sales pitch. Very professional and knowledgeable about solar batteries.The installation went well and the electricians did a great job with installing the solar battery. They were polite, punctual and didn't leave a mess after completing the job.The costumer service was fantastic and helped me with the grid connection after the installation.Overall I'm very impressed with 1KOMMA5° and very happy that I decided to purchase my solar battery with them.

The quoting process began shakily and I felt I was being charged too much for a battery that was too powerful for our 6.6 kWh solar panel system. We negotiated and they supplied the perfect battery for our solar system at a reasonable price. They were efficient, non-intrusive, tidied up and walked me through how to access and use the app to check on how the battery was functioning and thus optimise when to schedule the use of appliances. Even on cold cloudy days the panels produce energy and with the battery we hardly ever draw from the grid.

The team at 1komma5 impressed me with their professionalism, politeness and punctuality.  From Wayne's quick response to my initial enquiry to installation of additional solar panels, new inverter and large solar battery took 3 weeks.  A self sufficient solar system was installed in one morning by a team of polite young men who arrived punctually,  carried out the work professionally and neatly.  If 1komma5 were aiming to impress,  they succeeded.

Kozco were fantastic!!!!They were a tad dearer than we thought they would be but with 200klm to travel to get to us that was understandable. The guy we originally dealt with, (Paul), was great, keeping us informed of install dates and talking us through the proposed panels and inverter. The install crew were also great, they were quick, they explained everything they were doing as they were doing it and the operation of the system was explained to us really wellWhat really suprised was how well they cleaned up after themselves the area was left so clean you wouldn't have known they'd been. Very happy

Sales quoting process was easy and very manageable.The customer service was excellent and answered all my questions promptly and efficiently.The installation was excellent abd went off without a hitch.

All good so far.Sales/quoting process enjoyable - knowledge and advice imparted by the rep was good and non anxiety or pressure applied.I’m confident about the ease of coming installation.Time will tell about the  performance of the product

Little under a month in and we are essentially off grid.The sales communication was a little hap hazard around when the system would be installed. Prior that that the options presented were well explained with lots of flexibility.The installers were amazing. Punctual, friendly and respectful. The installers were also more than happy to answer questions, and the discussed all the options due to the complexity of our home.Overall very content.

We were seeking to add a battery to existing 15 kW ground mounted system to best utilise the PV and provide grid backup. As this was 100m from house and meter this provided a challenge to those who quoted. We were very happy with the sales advice and design ultimately deciding on a 30kW battery and additional 9.7 kW solar.The Installation on the steep high roof was professional and the electrics of battery inverter and additional switch board was efficient and very neat. Now 3 weeks after we are benefiting with only grid use when all air conditioning is running overnightLooking forward to see how it all performs over the next 12 mths

Great process for the quote ran through all options.Sometime between ordering and fitting.Installation prompt on time over and above due to some left off field things.Tidy job, shown set up and run down.

It was an extension of the existing system. The installation was going to be problematic - and it was! But in the end, thanks to Alan the electrician, everything got straightened up. Now the system is working as required.

A very quick quote, with two different inverter options provided when requested. A competitive quote and very efficient and cleanly done on install day. Installer explained key inverter features and set up the app. Only period where it was unclear and I needed to follow-up was while waiting for the company to schedule installation day. Overall very happy.

Great company to deal with.Quote process went smoothly, salesperson Daniel was very knowlegable and handled my many questions professionally and promptly, great communication.The installers (Alan & son) did a great job, were prefessional, and left the place tidy.The installer is Adelaide based - I was initially aprehensive about going with an installer who is located so far away, however there was no need for concern - they were prompt, great to work with, and even came out a couple of weeks after the install to deal with a minor issue I had with the system. The installers informed me they travel all over the state, it's nothing out of the ordinary for them.System is great, inverter and solar are working well, very happy. Now considering getting a battery through the same company.

The process was very straightforward from start to finish and Kozco were so obliging and courteous. They made sure I was happy with the solar panel positioning and you can’t see than at all! I highly recommend them. We can’t believe we didn’t do it sooner. I always thought it would be super complicated, but not at all. My power bill was $3 after the first fortnight, which is incredible after paying up to $250 each month. I am completely addicted to my solar app and check our power usage all the time.

Could not be happier with the experience with Kozco, from pre-sale all the way to post installation support the team from Kozco were always polite, prompt and professional.Pre-sale - very engaging salesperson, prompt to address queries and updates to the initial quote (a few times). Included a site visit, which was important for me.Post-sale - the salesperson remained engaged to ensure a seamless transition to the installation team.Installation - very quick to be scheduled, and kept to scheduled date. On the day, the team was prompt and professional. They showed what I would rate as a high level of attention to detail with the installation. This resulted in a very professional looking installation. I cannot highlight this enough, so many times a slick salesperson is followed by a sloppy installation team that leaves me feeling duped ... not with Kozco, the installation team were awesome.Post-installation - Kozco organised the smart meter installation with no input required from myself. The smart meter installer did cause the solar monitoring system to stop working and when I informed Kozco of the issue, they resolved it promptly with no issues.Bottom line - would not hesitate to recommend this installer - they were not the cheapest, but they were cost competitive and the outcome was a great experience and a happy customer!

Installers John, Sam, Hiep and Scott, I was very impressed and felt confident that these guys knew there craft.The team rocked up on time, John introduced himself, walked through the job, understood where items would be placed.(Ducted and Split System). Installation was discrete ensuring that all cables and pipes where well hidden.After installation team cleaned up and left my place tidy. Hiep spent the time to show me how the system worked, explained the warranty, also explained what maintenance was necessary demonstrated how to access the filters and clean them and how frequently.Like to also thank Adrian the rep that quoted the job, went to the trouble to review what rebates I was entitled to and completed the forms to make a claim.Good job Kozco.

I was looking to augment the solar panel system with additional panels and battery storage. Your assistance was sought regarding reliable suppliers/providers who could satisfy that requirement. The outcome of that were relatively early responses from 3 organisations you had listed as reliable. As it turned out, the representative from Kozco, Ben Norton, provided a most timely and complete quotation in response to my query. In addition, Ben provided additional, helpful advice on alternative battery options that would better suit the outcome we were seeking. The installation was carried out a few days before the promised date, with timely, advance notice provided by the installers who arrived early on the nominated day. The new set of solar panels were coupled with the existing ones to feed into the newly installed battery. All work was carried out satisfactorily and completed on the same day. Apparently, grid connection had been arranged by the installers before the installation date. The overall installation was fully operational and we were provided with a briefing on the completed system before the installers left the site. The installers left the site clean and tidy, taking with them discarded items and packaging.

Sales/ quoting- discussed all available options and pricing-  knowledgeable about all aspects of installation- site visit with planning out how it will fit and look once its installedInstallation- good communication on approximate  arrival time, when the power will be cut and how long- most things cleaned up afterwards- brief overview how system works and how to shut it down- Installation certificates provided via email afterwards, organised all grid connectionCustomer service- needed one thing adjusted post Installation, very quick to respond and sort it outOverall i will call on this company for future works.
Sales was easy and stayed on target.Install was timely and professional.Customer service was fine, no complaints
Fantastic installer, there was an initial issue with the inverter, the installer kept coming back attempting to fix it and made sure the issue was resolved before closing the job.

Ben was very helpful through the sales process and patiently answered all my questions.  He was responsive and could always be contacted in a reasonable time frame.The installers were professional, very helpful and consulted us along the way.Customer Service was also responsive to any questions I had as I learnt the system.

We were really happy to find Kozco through SolarQuotes. Pleasantly surprised at how affordable a large quality system was. Customer service was top-notch. In-home consultation was very excellent, I felt listened to and also got great advice. Installers were efficient, clean, friendly and took extra time to help us get online. After-sale service has been equally fantastic. Kozco have been excellent on every measure.
Quote from Kozco was excellent, explained everything in easy to understand terms. Install was quick and workmanship was excellent. Would highly reccomend Kozco for Solar.

Sales and quoting process went smoothly and explained various aspects of the components to be usedThe installation went  smoothly with the guys being punctual, tidy and politeSalesman followed up after the installation to ask how everything went I was 100% satisfied with the installation and the explanation on the working of lights on the inverter and the installation of the apt on my phoneI did have a disconnection of wi-fi  at one stage but was sorted out the next day nothing was not too much trouble
Sales person was approachable and installation was done by a professional team.
Great outcome tidy and punctual hopefully value for money and lasts for years.
While initially not the lowest price this company matched my best quote and took the time to go through all the details with meInstallation was top notch on a challenging weather day
Great service both in the quoting process and follow up. The installers were considerate and informative. I would recommend Kosco energy group….

Informative n knowledgeable salesperson, Ben. Installation was tidy and punctual. Customer Service was great, we got all the help with grid connection after the install. The solar system  is working well.

What a big decision getting solar is! Spending around $10k for a system is not a decision to be made lightly. We found we could trust solar quotes recommendations and then when the team from Kozco came and quoted we felt confident and comfortable with the information and process.
Very professional. Arrived at premises on time, completed work as scheduled and left residence in very neat and tidy manner.Also installed our ACU which was also performed to a very high standard.
Great pricing, excellent price after negotiating and installers were professional polite and kept me informed afll the way

Excellent salesperson, prompt installation with no residual mess. Very good dealing with tenants  connecting to internet. A few unfortunate hiccups and delays with correct invoicing and documentation but once we got back to the original saleperson, Ben Norton, all was sorted very promptly. We would recommend Kozco overall.

Kozco sales were knowledgeable and answered my dozen questions with confidence. Kozco gave me a competitive quote (not the lowest but very close). Their quote gave me a better Inverter, Panels and a good monitoring system.The installation went smoothly even though they were down one man on their crew. They were polite and took their time to explain system operations / monitoring on the day. The system was completed ahead of time. I purchased extra concrete tiles as expected some breakages and got none!The Inverter was installed in the garage where I had requested.Follow up after install has been good and an upgraded smart meter was arranged by the supplier which is happening today.

We recently discovered our tiled roof was leaking around where the solar panels were installed.  The initial contact was positive and someone got back to me and was going to arrange for someone to come out and have a look.  That was 2 months ago, all subsequent calls and email have gone unanswered.  I needed to get a roofer in who identified two cracked tiles and confirmed the tiles were most likely damaged during installation of the solar system.I would like to thank John (service manager) reaching out. We have now resolved the issues above to our satisfaction.

I was contacted by Ben Norton the day after I made an online enquiry with Kozco, which was much sooner than I expected.  Ben was very accommodating and had infinite patience for the many questions I had.  I felt reassured by his product knowledge and the personalised service.  Whilst these systems can be quite pricey, after speaking with Ben I had a clear understanding of the financial benefits in the long term, especially with investing in a quality product.  Ben followed up every enquiry promptly and kept in touch throughout the process.  Installation was within a month, moreso impressive as this period incorporate the Christmas and New Year periods and was a quick and efficient process.The installers were on time and very professional.  In the space of one day they removed 2 x other older solar systems from our roof and 2 x inverters and installed our new system.  By the end of the day it was up and running.Monitoring the system via Sungrow's handy iSolarCould app has been convenient and very easy.  In addition to designing a great system to meet our needs, Ben also provided handy tips to maximise efficiency with minor changes to our household habits.  Very happy with our system, Ben and Kozco - highly recommend them.

We initially contacted Kozco Energy for a system health check of our solar system,  (purchased from Sharpe Electrical in 2021and since gone out of business), as we have been concerned that our battery wasn't coming online when there were power outages. Danny and Ralph discovered that the battery backup had not been installed correctly by the original installers (Sharpe Electrical).  While doing the service Danny and Ralph also advised us that our switchboard was unsafe and should be upgraded. (we have had several electricians working on our property previously and none have mentioned that our switchboard was unsafe)Ralph and Danny did an excellent job upgrading our switchboard and also added a new power circuit for our fridge freezer, and gas HWS so that they were covered by the battery backup. They also liaised with Sonnen to check that the battery was operating correctly.Johnstone Maina from the Kozco office did an excellent job liaising with us and organising timings, Ralph and Danny were polite, good natured and punctual.
The installation team lead by Brad was fantastic.  The sales person Chris Toms provided all options and more in the discussions including new variations

I chose Kozco as the ad's I'd seen  and other reviews they seemed very professional.  I spoke with Harry,  he came and looked at the job location,sent an initial quote.  Had more questions and ideas and came up with the final version.The install team were great. A big job removing an older system replacing with a new one and battery installed.   Being an older house made it a bit harder.  Job finished and a great looking unit.Team were respectful and trusted.

I can thoroughly recommend Kozco Energy Group if you’re considering a Solar System. We were presented with a couple of installation proposals and Harry took the time to come and see us, inspect and explain our system options. Not all companies will take the time to come out, but I would highly recommend they do. Harry identified additional costs to our system that were required and it’s better to know these upfront. The installers and electrician were very amiable and did a great job on a very warm day. The after sales team have kept in touch and provided us with advice on certification and notifying our electricity retailer. Very pleased with the whole process and would recommend Kozco readily.

The customer service was great, very helpful and answered all my questions promptly and politely. The installers were all nice and friendly and very informative. Overall very happy with the service and product.

Had the pleasure of dealing with their sales representative Harry, who was fantastic and knowledgeable. Had their team come to install it, they arrived on time. They were all professional and didn't waste any time, couldn't reccomend this company enough!

I have just recently had a solar system installed through Kozco.  The salesperson Harry was very efficient and reliable and a great communicator, he kept in touch throughout sale and installation which was very much appreciated by me. He lsitened to my requirements and understood what I needed.  Alan who installed the unit and his offsider were friendly and efficient, and very patient while explaining the technology to me.  As a newby to solar, this treatment was greatly appreciated as I was quite nervous about such a big investment for me.  I can thoroughly recommend Kozco as they have been supportive througout the whole experience!  Thanks Kozco!!

Ralph did a great job in altering the switchboard so that the correct circuits were covered by the battery backup.He was friendly, knowledgeable & efficient. I would be happy to have him work on my system anytime  10/10

Sales/ quoting process went really well. The guys working on electricals and panels were polite/tidy and punctual. The guys organized the grid connection also, thanks to every one involved great job well done

From the first conversation with Harry to the completion of the installation. Harry and the team at Kozco took the time to listen to our needs and recommended a solar package to suit our situation. The installers were very professional and took time to explain how it all works.

Arrived at time specified. Were polite, friendly and easy going. Installation seemed to be quite fast. Cleaned up every thing and took any rubbish away with them. Guided us through the ap before leaving.

From start to finish Harry ensured everything went as planned. The installers were very professional and the quality of work excellent. Took time to explain how it all works and gave me some valuable advice. Well done Kozco.Maurice

Jonathon was very informative and helpful with working out our requirements.The installers did a great job, clean and tidy. Arrived on time, all very polite.No issues with grid connection.Customer service was a bit poor at times. Advised would confirm a time by phone, never received a call. Had to make several calls to find out what was happening. They were apologetic.Overall, satisfied with the job and the installers.

All good. The office was helpful and quickly responded to emails.  They turned up on the agreed day at the agreed time. Excellent tradesmen. Neat job, no mess and took me through the operation and discussed how we would add batteries later.
The whole process was handled very professionally. The company was great to deal with and the installers very polite. Overall a great result.

The Kozco rep (Harry) was a very informative and was able represent and explain in laymen's terms the way in whichHe suggested we should have a Kozco Solar system installed. He went to great lengths to explain the process involvedand provided us with updated information .. The final conversation with Harry was the total cost and we were totally surprised so we signed up straight away. We  believe that Harry has the potential to go onto big and better things and Kozco should be very proud  to have a company representative like him. We also have to take the opportunity to givethe installers ( Shaun Bright) and his boys for magnificent job. We would like to thank Mr Johnstone Mainia for his initialrecommendations to have our solar installed  by Kozco. What a great company to deal with. Five stars all round.
Great experience with professional sales and installation. Could not rate them any higher.
Installation went reasonably smoothly. Fast turnaround time to replace the circuit breaker (the wrong one had been installed).

The sales process was very good and the quote was selected because of the product & technology that suited my circumstances. However, the installation process & service was disappointing. They were 2 hours late arriving on day 1 and 1 hr on day two. I then had to point out an aspect of the positioning of some panels as they were not lined up. So a subsequent return visit was then necessary. As I work full time, the time wasted and needing to be around was frustrating. The connection to the grid has still not occurred 2 wks post completion of installation. Post installation and to the companies credit they acknowledged the feedback and the installation of the new meter was expedited and the company also provided some improved after sales support.

Wayne and the team at Kozco Energy made the process of purchasing Solar so easy. From the beginning of the quoting process to the final installation everything ran so smoothly and I was always kept up to date with everything. All my questions were answered promptly, and even on the day of install the team were super helpful at accommodating any needs that I had.Thanks so much to the team, highly recommended for your exceptional professionalism!

Right from the start, I had a sense of confidence and trust in what Kozco had to offer me as a solution to the needs of my household. They fully explained the recommended solar solution and savings to be made from my investment.On my acceptance of the quote, they gave me an installation date which was only 3 weeks away,which gave me time to prepare.The Kozco team of installers arrived precisely on time and were very professional, and answered my questions very thoroughly.A great job overall with a not one problem!Follow up from the admin team from Kozco was again fantastic and I would recommend them to anyone.

Wayne was an absolute pleasure to deal with in regards to the quote, very informative of all information needed and made the process easy. The installers were neat, tidy and respectful and would highly recommend using Kozco for any solar/electrical needs.

We are absolutely delighted with our new solar and battery system purchased from Kozco Energy Group. Their team helped us navigate the options for the best system to suit our home and then worked with us while we replaced the roof prior to installation. We found their communication to be first class, and the installation staff were polite, professional and left a clean site.The whole process for us - from purchase to system handover - was effortless.We also use Kozco to maintain our Actron Air air-conditioner. The maintenance admin team, and staff that visit our home, are excellent.We would happily recommend Kozco
Installation on time. Installers did a great job. Very tidy and explained the workings and set the app for me. Very polite. Brandon checked up after installation to see if everything was OK.

We couldn’t have been happier with our sales and installation experience from the Kozco team.On the sales side, Matt was easily the most professional and pro-active of the people we spoke to from the 3 companies recommended by Solar Quotes. He went out of his way to present us with a number of options to best suit our needs.The installation team were also very impressive with their friendly professionalism and the efficient way they dealt with the challenges of weather and COVID disruptions on our job.While we did experience a frustrating period of lack of communication in resolving an issue with the Consumption Meter ceasing to work after SA Power installed the new smart meter, our faith in Kozco’s after sales service has been more than restored by the prompt and positive way they have handled a recent inverter warranty claim.Overall, we’re more than happy with our choice of Kozco Energy Group for the solar system on our home.
Absolutely brilliant from knowledge to sale and after service the best

From an excellent sales quoting through to timely and professional install, we were delighted.  Reece quoted an excellent proposal and was very responsive to any query.  Shaun and his team were on time, worked solidly and cleanly and explained the processes and app brilliantly.  The admin, financial & support team have been totally professional.  100% satisfied with our Kozco experience. Stephanie, Tom & Jessica @ admin have likewise been brilliant.

From our first contact we found Kozco Energy Group provided excellent communication; from receiving our quote to site inspection and installation arrangements. The sales consultant listened to our request and was polite and punctual. He also visited our off grid rural property to ensure the system would be suitable and arranged further site works required for our complete 'off grid' system. I highly recommend Kozco Energy Group for all your solar requirements.
A1 service and install. I am very happy with the inverter and no concerns to date. I would highly recommend the Kozco Energy group to family and friends.

The re-installation was necessitated by inverter failure at 10 years. I considered the original installation had been of poor quality with loose wires draped across the roof collecting leaves and debris and an ugly configuration of the cabling. My particular needs were well understood and intelligently approached in the design configuration offered. This has proven very cost effective.Performance has exceeded the predicted. The design/sales team were prompt efficient, well informed and seamlessly moved to installation.The installation involved a large engaged team who arrived at the stated time and had the manpower and the confident engaged approach needed. It is 10 years since the first install but the contrast in competence and the installation process was remarkably different. Blowers, vacuums and brooms kept the whole work area tidy.The design strategy, quality of installation and the cost effectiveness of the upgrade were excellent.

The guy at Kozco Energy Group did a fantastic job, on time quick and tidy and very professional, easy to deal with, they did everything. All paperwork and organised all by them . I did have to do anything

From start to finish kozco did a great job. We were recommended from a friend who had a positive experience. Sales were polite and did a site visit, very quick to get back with a competitive price. The install team kept the site clean and was quicker than what i thought it would take. Being a brand new house there was no damage to the roof or gutters cause of the gutter protection. Would definitely recommend!

I specified the panels and inverter I wanted. Kozco offered the most competitive price. Salesperson was excellent - informative, quick to respond and knowledgable. Follow up from office people was effcient and friendly. Installation was smooth and quick and followed up with clear explanation of the systems functionality and online monitoring. Overall, an excellent experience.

From the beginning, the entire process was smooth and efficiently completed. Reece was very helpful and always responded on time. Workmanship was extraordinary. The team that installed my Solar and ducted reverse cycle air conditioning system’s were highly trained, friendly and went the extra mile making sure that the systems installed work efficiently, look the best and ensuring customer satisfaction. I highly recommend the.
Sales / Quoting good. Installers were punctual, polite and removed all Rubbish. Everything was organised and carried out in a professional manner. After sales service has been excellent.

Quote process was simple and straightforward. They gave me good options and offered alternatives to what I thought I needed. Installed 4 weeks later and I am very happy with the device and quality all around.

Installation I was left extremely dissatisfied. Followed by on-going failed promises.The panel plan changed several times in the install day with installers and sales team not agreeing on solutions.Inverter was mounted within 5mm of garage panel door's pathway. Likely to be damaged 1 day, they realised the error when i pointed it out as they installed with door open and didn't look/check.Damaged/cracked a tile they drilled through, told me they would change it over with spare which I offered them, even though sales told me it would be at their expense. They hid it instead and lied about it putting silicone over the top, then later blamed their apprentice and took no responsibility for it until I held off final payment. Other cracks and tile misplacement too.Panels were left filthy. Suncream hand prints all over.Solar panel black frames were all scratched up2 Panel rails extended very dodgy due to not measuring correctly and panel moves while others are fixed.Tv antenna was not moved as advised. Left with shaded panels and a bird nesting area directly over panel. It is now useless with bird droppings covering it. Resolution offer was to charge me a further $500 even though it was agreed the entire way through by sales team to have been discussed and part of the job.Cables in roof were strung without support, earth outside of condute.I'm dissatisfied and annoyed that there was little effort to fix the issues.It took over a month to replace the tile and fix cables. Other issues remain, left with a $250 discount to have someone else look at antenna. Didn't even have the professionalism to call back and discuss it, accounts were left to show it on the bill.They advised they'll have the antenna moved yet I've waited over yet another month now. Still no action. Panels covered in bird droppings rendering useless they knew from day 1 this was an issue.They agreed to outsource this antenna job to avoid any further reputation risk as their young installer wasn't confident and visited 3 times to say it's too difficult. There are next day businesses available to do this work so shouldn't be waiting for it for months.Told me they want a 5 star review after all this as it could impact their business and yet I'm still waiting on what I paid forTried to make me feel bad about leaving the review after they actually requested it. This is 100% honest and they've had plenty of time to act or even do the right thing in the first place!Be aware, do not finalise your payment until "happy", check their work!!!

The Kozco Group was easy to deal with, gave me reasonable price for the product I wanted. Quoting process was relatively smooth and the salesperson understood my solar system requirements. The technicians were punctual and hard working. Considering there was half the crew on the instalation day, they made sure the job was done. Thank you Kozco.

I am very pleased with my interactions with Kozco Energy Group for installation of my solar panels. After getting a few quotes and doing my research I went with them as I liked the brand of solar panels they installed (Trina) with the Enphase microinverters, and I was not going to install a battery at this time. The quote by Matt was very punctual and on site. After getting other quotes, I was able to amend my initial quote (remove the battery) which was easily done and thus the decision came to use them.The installation was tidy. They required an extra half day to install all the panels which was fine. And Shaun came back to set up the IT infrastructure so I can now see my energy production from my smartphone.Very happy with their service, and they provide yearly cleaning of the panels which is great. Would highly recommend them.

From our first conversation on the phone until the last solar panel went up we were thoroughly pleased with Kozco.Such polite people, whatever was said they would do -was done! They replied promptly to my messages and questionsThey were punctual and cleaned up after the work was completed.They followed up to make sure all was working properly. I wouldn’t hesitate recommending Kozco!We’ve even had our air conditioner serviced by Kozco and the technician was so lovely, polite and helped us understand how it all worked. Thanks Kozco!

From the first phone call to Matt (plug for Lobethal Footy Club's home game newsletter)-To the follow up email last week when the system is nearly a month old, the team at Kozco have been, friendly, polite, timely, courteous, efficient and patient, especially Matt with my 101 questions and counting.The installation crew were on time and respectful of property and "Nick- the battery guy" a font of information and patience. Thank you to the staff in the office for organising AGL etc etc,They were one of 3 initial quotes and they were upfront about costs and requirements and also very helpful on the battery vs no battery without pressure either way. (We went with battery and have been 98% self sufficient since)Value for money and quality of system stars are only after 4 weeks, but it's looking good so far! I would definitely recommend Kozco to others.

This system was by far the best value out of several quotes received. Sales person was fantastic and the team have been very good with communication regarding installation (still to go ahead this week).
Sales process very professional installed by friendly helpful tradies who ensured I could use app and understood system.

I've got a few different quotes from different companies but I went with the Kozco because they are based in Adelaide and has a high rating with some good reviews.I definitely made the right decision, from the beginning of the process to the end, everything was perfect and they even checked my neighbour's solar system to build and design a better solar system for my house.Especially, thanks to Matt who quoted my system and took care of the installation process. I would highly recommend their service and professional.

We met the Kozco Group sales rep Stephanie at the Home Show 2022.I explained my reluctance in having solar & her explanation put me at ease somewhat at that time.We were provided a detailed proposal of the system that suited our needs inc project timeline, roof panel layout including battery storage together with inverters (2x), panels (31x) & battery (1x) specs.Stephanie & the admin team kept in contact with us from proposal date June 22 to install date July 22. We could not fault the communication.Our installer Ryan & his team answered all the questions my husband had for them fully which gave us a sense of trust in the entire process.Trades were polite, professional, tidy & very punctual. Our AlphaESS system comes with an app which we access from our phones & Ryan explained the functions to my husband.
